Sunny Deol's new film 'Ikka' trailer released, featuring courtroom drama

The trailer for the upcoming film 'Ikka' has been released, featuring actor Sunny Deol in a courtroom setting. Deol reprises a role reminiscent of his performance in 'Damini', delivering powerful dialogues. The film also stars Akshay Khanna, and the trailer suggests a suspenseful narrative.
